rules.title: A sensor board and its magnet are mounted from measurements
rules.statement: A part that holds a sensor board or a magnet: the board is fastened through its own holes, every pin row has a wire window, and the magnet pocket is cut for the magnet measured in hand.
rules.why: A sensor bridge was printed with pilots at the corners of the board. A link was printed with a pocket for a magnet the owner never had: 1 mm loose a side.

attest.question: Sensor board or magnet on this part: how is the board fastened, where do the wires of every pin row leave, and which measured magnet is the pocket for?
labels: no sensor board and no magnet on this part
board through its own holes; a window behind every pin row; magnet pocket from the measured magnet

rules.note: Deferred: hardware.bought_from_step asks for the measured board and magnet today. Remove "deferred" to ask one question for three rules: sensors.board_through_own_holes, sensors.wire_windows, sensors.magnet_pocket.

rules.title: A bought board is screwed through its own holes
rules.statement: A bought board is fastened through its own mounting holes, not clamped by pilots at its corners. Its pocket locates it. At least {sensors.pilot_floor_min} of plastic stays under a self-tapping pilot. Hole pitch and outline come from a caliper: sizes read from a photo stay D until they are measured.
rules.why: A sensor bridge was printed with pilots at the corners of the board; the board sizes had been read from a photo.
rules.note: The measured board is asked through hardware.bought_from_step; sensors.board_and_magnet is deferred.

rules.title: Every pin row has a wire window
rules.statement: Every pin row of a board has a wire window through the part behind it, as wide as the row and running to the pocket wall, with no ledge left at the wall. A seat that reaches one row only is a defect.
rules.why: A seat was cut that reached one pin row only; the first window left a 0.3 mm ledge at the wall.
rules.note: Text only today: sensors.board_and_magnet is deferred.

rules.title: A magnet pocket is cut for the measured magnet
rules.statement: A magnet pocket is cut for the magnet measured in hand: {sensors.magnet_pocket_d} wide (the magnet plus {sensors.magnet_d_extra}) and {sensors.magnet_pocket_depth} deep (the magnet plus {sensors.magnet_depth_extra}), from the same mouth so that the gap to the sensor does not move, with at least {sensors.magnet_floor_min} of floor behind it. The gap stays inside the window the sensor's data sheet gives.
rules.why: A printed link carried a pocket for a larger magnet than the one in hand: 1 mm loose a side and 1 mm too deep. An older pocket had no floor.
rules.note: The measured magnet is asked through hardware.bought_from_step, and the pocket shows up as a hole of the census; sensors.board_and_magnet is deferred.
